focus: 為規格決策辯護：決定 → 限制 → 取捨 → 補救
lead: 今天練的是：為一個規格決策辯護。重點不是英文漂亮，而是讓對方聽得出「這是想過的決定，不是妥協」。所有 speaking 段落請先出聲講完再看 model answer。

phrases.en: We looked at three options and landed on…
phrases.gl: 我們評估過三個方案，最後選定 ——（顯示做過功課）
phrases.ex: We looked at three sensor configs and landed on the 8MP rolling-shutter module for the next platform build.

phrases.en: The trade-off is A for B.
phrases.gl: 我們用 A 換 B（取捨講得乾淨，不用解釋一長串）
phrases.ex: The trade-off is motion distortion for resolution — we get 8MP now instead of 2MP in Q4.

phrases.gl: 這個決定真正的關鍵因素是 ——（把主因點名，避免發散）
phrases.ex: What drove that decision was vendor lead time, not cost.

phrases.en: The constraint is X, so the spec follows from that.
phrases.gl: 限制條件是 X，規格是由這個限制推導出來的
phrases.ex: The constraint is 400 GB per vehicle per day, so the 10 Hz logging rate follows from that.

phrases.en: It's a deliberate choice, not a limitation.
phrases.gl: 這是刻意選的，不是我們做不到（擋掉「你們能力不足」的誤解）
phrases.ex: Dropping raw frames after 30 days is a deliberate choice, not a limitation.

phrases.en: Let me walk you through how the data flows.
phrases.gl: 我帶你走一遍資料流（要講架構前先給對方地圖）
phrases.ex: Let me walk you through how the data flows from the camera to the labeling queue.

phrases.en: The trigger to revisit this would be…
phrases.gl: 什麼情況我們會重新檢討這個決定（把決策留活口，非常 PM）
phrases.ex: The trigger to revisit this would be cut-in recall dropping below 85% on the highway set.

phrases.gl: 中文「因為…所以…」不能兩邊都留；英文只留一邊
phrases.ex: Bandwidth was the hard limit. That's why we decided to cap logging at 10 Hz.

phrases.gl: 用數字取代「應該沒問題」——從「希望」變成「已驗證」
phrases.ex: We've validated that at 120 km/h on the test track — distortion stays under two pixels.
phrases.fix: 取代 "It should be no problem"

setup: Setup. You're in the logging-spec review for the next platform build. You froze the front camera at 8MP rolling shutter and the synchronized log rate at 10 Hz with hardware timestamps. Alan, the perception tech lead, wanted a 2MP global-shutter module and full 30 Hz raw capture, and he's unhappy. Your two real constraints were vendor lead time (global shutter slips to Q4) and in-vehicle storage (400 GB/vehicle/day). David, the program manager, is in the room and only wants to know how exposed the program is.

prompts.q: Alan: “Before we move on — walk us through why you went with rolling shutter.”
prompts.frame: Decision in one line → the constraint → options considered → why this one won → what we gave up + how it's covered.
prompts.say: 先出聲講完整段（目標 40–50 秒），再展開 model answer。
prompts.model: “Sure. We froze on the 8MP rolling-shutter module for the next platform build. The constraint that drove it was lead time — the global-shutter part doesn't land until Q4, and we need cars on the road in September to hit the milestone. We looked at three configs: 2MP global shutter, 8MP rolling shutter, and a mixed setup with global shutter on the front only. The mixed one was cleanest technically but added a second supplier and about six weeks of integration, so we ruled it out. The trade-off is motion distortion for resolution and schedule. What we gave up is clean geometry on fast lateral motion, and we're covering that by keeping the rolling-shutter correction in the preprocessing step and flagging any frame where the row delay exceeds our threshold.”

prompts.q: Alan: “But at 10 Hz we lose fast cut-ins. Doesn't that make the whole dataset useless for the cut-in scenarios we actually care about?”
prompts.frame: Acknowledge the real part → separate what's true from what's overstated → give one number → offer a narrow, scoped exception.
prompts.say: 先出聲回一次（不要說 "I think maybe"、不要道歉開場），再看 model answer。
prompts.model: “That's a fair concern, and you're right that 10 Hz is thin for lateral motion. Where I'd push back is ‘useless' — we ran the numbers on last quarter's set, and at 10 Hz we still capture a full cut-in in about nine out of ten cases; what we lose is the first frame or two of the maneuver. So it hurts onset timing, not detection. Here's what I can do: rather than lifting the whole pipeline to 30 Hz, let's define a trigger-based burst — when the radar sees a lateral velocity spike, we log at 30 Hz for three seconds. That gets you the frames you care about without blowing the storage budget. Can you and I size that this week?”

prompts.q: David: “Plain answer, Momo — if this call turns out to be wrong, what does it cost us?”
prompts.frame: Name the risk in one sentence → what we'd see if it's going wrong → the trigger to revisit → cost and timing of reversing.
prompts.say: 出聲講，控制在 30 秒內。
prompts.model: “Plain answer: the risk is that rolling-shutter artifacts hold back cut-in performance, and we don't see it clearly until the highway validation in October. What we'd see first is cut-in recall stalling on the highway set while everything else improves. The trigger to revisit is recall under 85% there. If we hit that, we swap in the global-shutter module on the next hardware revision — that's a re-collection of roughly six weeks of highway data and about a month of schedule, but it doesn't invalidate the labeling work or the model architecture. So the downside is real but it's contained, and September ships either way.”

fixes.bad: We discuss about the camera spec yesterday and finally decide to use rolling shutter.
fixes.good: We discussed the camera spec yesterday and decided on rolling shutter.
fixes.note: Grammar：discuss 後面不加 about；過去的事要用過去式。另外 finally 帶「終於受不了」的抱怨感，「最後決定」直接用 decided 就好。

fixes.bad: Because the bandwidth is limited, so we cut the logging rate to 10 Hz.
fixes.good: Bandwidth was the hard limit, so we cut the logging rate to 10 Hz.
fixes.note: Grammar：中文「因為…所以…」兩邊都要，英文只能留一邊 —— 留 because 或留 so，不能並存。

fixes.bad: The accuracy is very very good, I think it should be no problem for the review.
fixes.good: Accuracy is holding up well — 91% recall on the night set — so I'm confident it'll clear the review.
fixes.note: Register + directness：very very 在會議裡聽起來不專業；should be no problem 是希望不是證據。用一個數字換成可驗證的說法。

fixes.bad: Our vendor didn't deliver global shutter module until Q4, so we don't have choice.
fixes.good: Our vendor can't deliver the global-shutter module until Q4, so we don't have a choice.
fixes.note: Grammar：冠詞不能掉（the module、a choice）；講未來的供貨限制用 can't，不是過去式 didn't。

fixes.bad: Please kindly note that this decision is already confirmed by our side.
fixes.good: Just to be clear — we've locked this decision on our side.
fixes.note: Register：please kindly 是公文腔，會讓你聽起來像小心翼翼在求人；被動 + by our side 也弱化了你的立場。用主動語態、第一人稱複數。

challenge:
今天在真實會議裡用這一個句型（只要一次就算成功）：

“We looked at ___ and ___, and landed on ___. What drove it was ___. The trade-off is ___, and we're covering that by ___.”

錄音作業（60 秒，手機錄）：用英文解釋你目前手上任何一個規格決定 —— 為什麼這樣選、放棄了什麼、什麼情況會回頭改。

  • 禁用：I think maybe、should be no problem、Because…, so…
  • 必須出現至少一個具體數字
  • 錄完自己聽一次，只抓一件事來修，不要全部重錄
check: 我能不看稿、在 45 秒內講完一個決策：決定 → 限制 → 取捨 → 補救？
今天講話時我有沒有一次都沒用到 “I think maybe” 和 “Because…, so…”？
被質疑的時候，我有先承認對方講對的部分，再劃出我不同意的那一塊嗎？
